text:
nina: hey everyone :wave: i just opened my first PR for service-x: https://github.com/redwood/service-x/pull/7. two quick q's — are we supposed to commit generated protos into the repo? and what's our preferred commit message format? thanks!

sam: welcome Nina! :tada: short answers: don't commit generated protos; run the gen target locally so only the source proto changes land. commit message format is conventional-ish: type(scope): short summary. we typically squash & merge.

marta: adding the devex guide link: https://intranet.redwood.dev/pr-guide — see the "generated artifacts" section and the branch/PR size guidelines. branch pattern we prefer: feat/<ticket>-short-desc or fix/<ticket>-short-desc.

nina: thanks — my PR accidentally contains generated files because i ran the build first. what's the cleanest way to remove them from this branch without dropping my code changes?

tyler: if the gen files are committed in your branch, remove them then regenerate during CI. steps i usually follow:
```bash
# reset the generated files to upstream (preserve your proto edits)
git fetch origin main
git checkout origin/main -- path/to/generated/*
# regenerate locally (writes to gen output)
make gen-protos
# stage only the real source .proto changes and any manual code you added
git add path/to/protos/*.proto
git commit -m "feat(service-x): add proto for thing (proto only)"
```
This way the generated files stay out of the commit history for the feature branch.

sam: CI will fail if generated files differ from what's expected. Also watch CODEOWNERS — if you touch that area you need the team to approve. Add reviewers by tagging @team-service-x or pick individuals. Small PRs get faster reviews. If lint complains run `yarn lint --fix` and `make test-unit`.

ci-bot: ci-bot: build #1289 • FAILED — tests/unit • gofmt mismatch: proto/gen/service.pb.go

olivia: assigning @sam to review. Nina, i can jump in if you get stuck for >30m. happy to pair.

nina: thanks everyone. i've removed the gen files, ran `make gen-protos` and updated only the .proto. pushing the fix now.

tyler: one more note on commit msgs: we prefer a two-line body for context. example template we use: 

"feat(service-x): add handler for thing"

"Why: adds initial handler used by X
Tags: relates #1234"

not required but helps changelogs.

marta: if you want, we can do a quick 15-min pairing to walk through the gen flow — ping me when you're ready.

nina: yes please — 3pm works for me.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll take a look after the green build. merge strategy is squash and merge once approvals + CI are green.

nina: awesome, thanks all :pray: this was super helpful — will update the PR and ping when green.
